title: Interface Designer / Web Developer
description:
Location: The role is fully remote. However, given our team’s current setup and time-zone alignment, we have a preference for candidates based in Europe, Latin America, or Mexico. 

Who We Are


COMO DL S.A., operating under the brand 'COMO Digital Life', is a regulated payment institution in Luxembourg. As a SWIFT member, COMO DL offers SEPA and SWIFT payments and issues multi-currency LU IBANs.  


COMO Digital Life is revolutionizing corporate banking and treasury management with a next-generation, fully digitalized financial platform. Headquartered in Luxembourg COMO blends advanced cloud-native technology, rigorous compliance, and a user-first approach to set a new global standard in financial services. 


We believe great companies are built on clarity, care, and collaboration. If you’re ambitious, love creating new opportunities, and want to grow your career in a dynamic international environment, this is the place for you. 

Role Overview  


As a full-time remote Interface Designer / Web Developer at COMO, you will be responsible for building, deploying, and optimizing user-centric digital interfaces across COMO’s platforms. You will play a pivotal role in translating design concepts into functional, responsive, and accessible web experiences that embody COMO’s brand identity and meet the highest standards of usability and performance. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you will ensure that all digital touchpoints are engaging, reliable, and aligned with the company’s vision. 


Key Responsibilities  


  • Deployment & Implementation: Develop, configure, and maintain website pages on platforms such as WixStudio, Webflow, and MS Azure. Ensure seamless integration of pre-designed screens while optimizing for performance, security, and scalability. Guarantee cross-browser compatibility, consistent branding, and operational excellence across devices. 
  • User Experience Development: Design and refine intuitive user journeys that address client and partner needs. Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business and user requirements into impactful digital solutions. 
  • User Interface Engineering: Transform design assets into interactive, user-friendly interfaces. Apply best practices in layout, typography, color, and accessibility to deliver interfaces that are both visually appealing and functional. 
  • Wireframing & Prototyping: Create and iterate on wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes to test concepts, gather stakeholder feedback, and enhance usability before full-scale implementation. 
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough reviews, testing, and debugging of deployed solutions. Ensure compliance with brand guidelines, technical specifications, and accessibility standards, delivering polished and reliable outcomes. 
  • Design System Integration: Contribute to the development and maintenance of COMO’s design system. Ensure components and patterns are consistently applied to achieve scalability and alignment across digital products. 
  • Responsive & Adaptive Design: Implement designs that adapt fluidly to various devices and screen sizes, ensuring seamless user experiences on desktop, tablet, and mobile. 
  • Accessibility Compliance: Apply WCAG and other accessibility standards to guarantee inclusive digital products. Perform accessibility audits and implement improvements as required. 
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work in partnership with designers, marketers, and developers to deliver projects on time and to the highest quality. Communicate technical approaches clearly, aligning design and development decisions with business goals. 
  • Continuous Learning & Innovation: Keep pace with evolving platforms, frameworks, and industry best practices. Experiment with new tools and methods to enhance COMO’s web platforms and bring forward innovative digital experiences. 


Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Web Development, Computer Science, or related field. 
  • Minimum 3-5 years of professional experience in web development, ideally within a corporate or B2B environment. 
  • Demonstrated expertise in multiple modern web development platforms (e.g., WixStudio, Webflow, MS Azure) as well as strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive frameworks. 
  • Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, accessibility standards, and cross-browser compatibility. 
  • Experience with prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe XD) and design-to-code workflows. 
  • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development practices. 
  • Knowledge of financial services or banking industry standards is advantageous. 
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus. 
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills. 
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks effectively, and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines. 
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and adaptable to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment. 


What We Offer  


  • A pivotal role at the forefront of fintech innovation in a triple-A-rated country. 
  • A dynamic, supportive work environment that values forward-thinking and proactive engagement. 
  • Ample opportunities for personal and professional development in a mission-driven organization. 
  • Competitive compensation. 
  • A strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and social responsibility. 


How to Apply


Send your CV and cover letter in English to with the subject “Interface Designer / Web Developer ”. Short-listed candidates will be contacted within two weeks.

title: Coordenador(a) Pedagógico(a) – Bilíngue
description:
Responsável por liderar o planejamento e a execução pedagógica do programa bilíngue, acompanhando professores, alunos e famílias. Atuar garantindo a qualidade do ensino, o alinhamento curricular e o desenvolvimento integral dos alunos, com foco em resultados acadêmicos e formação docente contínua.


Responsabilidades principais:

  • Coordenar e acompanhar o planejamento pedagógico das turmas bilíngues.
  • Supervisionar o desenvolvimento acadêmico e socioemocional dos alunos.
  • Apoiar e formar professores, promovendo práticas pedagógicas consistentes e atualizadas.
  • Garantir a aplicação e o alinhamento do currículo bilíngue às diretrizes da escola.
  • Manter comunicação próxima e colaborativa com famílias e equipe gestora.
  • Acompanhamento do plano pedagógico junto aos professores.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Pedagogia, Letras ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada em coordenação pedagógica.
  • Fluência em inglês (oral e escrita).
  • Conhecimento de metodologias bilíngues e práticas inovadoras de ensino.
  • Perfil de liderança, organização e excelente comunicação interpessoal.

title: Power BI Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Power BI Developer, Remote mode in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Power BI, databricks, Azure, SQL

Python

Identify components in need of testing and prioritize the writing of those tests;

Work on POCs, small development/enhancement projects;

Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and client success staff to ensure the best-possible testing is achieved;

Understand business goals and requirements and take them into consideration when creating tests;

Improve our QA tooling and continuous testing within our CI/CD framework;

Collaborate within the Agile framework, foster a team approach to software development and delivery;

Create test plans and run them as needed;

Create and manage defect tickets for new and existing functionality;

Assist in release/deployment planning and execution activities;

Exercise independent judgement and discretion to define the issues and develop solutions to complex problems that require innovation and ingenuity;

Provide accurate level of effort time estimates and provide recommendations for feature prioritization;

Coordinate with internal teams to understand requirements and provide technical solutions;

Anticipate security issues, bugs, performance and scalability issues prior to them coming to pass;

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Professor(a) Ensino Fundamental - ANOS INICIAIS
description:
Resumo do cargo

O(a) professor(a) dos Anos Iniciais é responsável por conduzir o processo de ensino e aprendizagem de forma significativa, estimulando o desenvolvimento acadêmico e socioemocional dos alunos. Para o cargo, é essencial demonstrar experiência, domínio pedagógico e habilidade para criar experiências de aprendizagem e ser uma pessoa acolhedora.

Esse papel é central na organização, pois representa o elo direto entre a proposta pedagógica da Kingdom e a vivência diária dos estudantes, consolidando nossos pilares de excelência, formação integral e afeto.


Responsabilidades
  • Planejar e conduzir aulas alinhadas à proposta pedagógica da escola, promovendo o desenvolvimento integral dos alunos.
  • Avaliar o progresso dos estudantes por meio de observações, registros e instrumentos avaliativos diversificados.
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas, formações e projetos interdisciplinares.
  • Manter comunicação constante e positiva com famílias e equipe escolar.
  • Colaborar com a coordenação pedagógica no aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de ensino.
Qualificações
  • Graduação completa em Pedagogia (ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino fundamental – anos iniciais.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e em ambiente colaborativo.
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Comprometimento com a formação integral e com os valores da Kingdom School.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior - Python/React
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A vaga é para uma empresa recém adquirida pelo iFood, eles possuem uma plataforma tecnológica voltada ao setor de food service, que digitaliza e automatiza toda a operação de restaurantes. Oferece módulos como cardápio digital, gestão de pedidos, delivery e relatórios analíticos. A solução é integrada, funciona mesmo offline e atende desde pequenos negócios até grandes redes.



Sobre o Papel

Como Desenvolvedor FullStack Sênior - Python e React, você será responsável por:


Responsabilidades

  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento de aplicações web de ponta utilizando as tecnologias Python e React;
  • Trabalhar em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a concepção da aplicação até a sua implantação;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de Produto e Design para traduzir requisitos em soluções técnicas eficientes;
  • Escrever código de alta qualidade, bem documentado e testado;
  • Identificar e implementar melhorias constantes nos processos e na arquitetura da aplicação;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e dar suporte técnico à equipe, sempre buscando o crescimento coletivo.



Habilidades Necessárias

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Python e suas principais bibliotecas (Django, Flask, etc.);
  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de aplicações web com React.js;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacionais (SQL) e não relacionais (NoSQL);
  • Habilidade em desenvolver APIs RESTful e trabalhar com arquiteturas orientadas a microserviços;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git) e metodologias ágeis;
  • Bom entendimento de conceitos de infraestrutura e implantação de aplicações (containerização, CI/CD, etc.);
  • Comunicação eficaz, proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.


Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

title: Backend Developer (NestJS & TypeScript)
description:
Sobre a YellowIpe


Temos a missão de inspirar a conexão da tecnologia com as pessoas, fomentamos o melhor de nossos profissionais através de nossa expertise em encontrar e atrair os melhores talentos para os melhores projetos.

O Foco nas Pessoas, Colaboração e Comprometimento são os pilares que nos guiam nessa trajetória.


Junte-se à equipa amarela como nosso novo Backend Developer (NestJS & TypeScript)!


Responsabilidades:


  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter aplicações backend de alta performance, principalmente com NestJS e TypeScript
  • Aplicar consistentemente os princípios SOLID , Clean Code e Design Patterns para garantir um código limpo, manutenível e escalável
  • Desenhar e implementar soluções baseadas em arquitetura de eventos , utilizando tecnologias como GCP Pub/Sub para garantir a comunicação assíncrona e desacoplada entre serviços
  • Trabalhar ativamente com o ecossistema de nuvem GCP , incluindo serviços como Cloud Run , Cloud Storage (Buckets) , entre outros
  • Modelar e otimizar bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server ) e NoSQL (MongoDB )
  • Desenvolver e manter Stored Procedures em SQL Server para lógica de negócios complexa e otimização de performance
  • Utilizar Redis para caching e melhoria de performance das aplicações
  • Colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares (Produto, QA, DevOps) para definir, projetar e entregar novas funcionalidades
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentor(a) para desenvolvedores(as) de níveis júnior e pleno
  • Realizar Code Reviews criteriosos para garantir a qualidade e a conformidade com os padrões de desenvolvimento
  • Manter e/ou dar suporte a sistemas legados ou componentes desenvolvidos em C# (nível básico/intermédio)


Requisitos:


  • Experiência sólida e comprovada como Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior
  • Profundo conhecimento em NestJS e TypeScript
  • Domínio dos princípios SOLID , Clean Code e principais Design Patterns
  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , incluindo Pub/Sub , Cloud Run e Cloud Storage
  • Excelente conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server ), incluindo criação e otimização de Stored Procedures
  • Experiência com bancos NoSQL , especialmente MongoDB
  • Experiência prática com Redis (caching)
  • Conhecimento básico em C# e no ecossistema .NET
  • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico
  • Excelentes capacidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento em outras plataformas de nuvem (AWS )
  • Experiência com ferramentas de containerização e orquestração (Docker , Kubernetes )
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento avançado em C#
  • Inglês desejável.

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Technical Project Manager  – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks
description:
We are seeking a Technical Project Manager – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks with strong expertise in mobile and converged network architectures to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Nokia network solutions, virtualization technologies, and key signaling protocols, and will play a crucial role in aligning network strategies with customer and business objectives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support mobile networks (2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G) and fixed/converged network architectures.
  • Manage and optimize virtualized environments using Nokia CBIS VMs , containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud platforms such as NCS.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Short-term Project)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Mobile Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience in mobile application development to work for our U.K. / U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in native or cross-platform framework development to make tech stack and architectural decisions, as well as build an initial MVP that will become a core tool powering the client's operations and data delivery.

The project must start by mid-November 2025 and will last 3 to 6 months.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Take complete ownership of the development of a mobile application that will become a core tool powering the client's operations and data delivery
  • Deliver a robust, performant MVP that supports offline usability, reliable data sync, and scalable architecture
  • Design and implement the complete lifecycle architecture, development, QA, and deployment in coordination with the Tech Lead
  • Collaborate with product and platform engineers to ensure consistency of data models and APIs
  • Guide the client's future mobile technology choices (native vs. hybrid), embedding best practices and maintainable patterns from the start


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience in mobile application development for both iOS and Android
  • Deep expertise with native development (e.g., Swift, Kotlin, React Native) and proven experience delivering to production OR experience with cross-platform frameworks (e.g., React Native, Flutter), combined with comfort extending native features
  • Strong understanding of offline data handling, synchronization, and API-driven integration
  • Experience balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term scalability
  • Excellent communication and ability to self-manage in a distributed team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Web Designer Senior
description:
⚠️ English fluency is a must for this role ⚠️

⚠️A challenge will be required ⚠️


Who We Are


Hey there! We’re Uitify, a creative design studio delivering premium UI/UX and branding for early-stage SaaS startups in the US. We help founders turn vision into beautifully functional design. If you're all about detail, innovation, and creating modern digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.


What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for a Senior Web Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and build high-converting, visually stunning websites. You’ll own web projects from idea to execution, working closely with founders, marketers, and our internal design team. If you’re a Framer expert, know how to design for impact, and care about both beauty and usability—we want you.


What You’ll Do


  • Design and build standout websites using Framer (bonus: Webflow skills);
  • Collaborate with clients to understand goals and translate them into compelling web experiences;
  • Work closely with UX/UI and branding to ensure cohesion across touchpoints;
  • Build landing pages, homepages, product pages, and more;
  • Help evolve and maintain web design systems and components;
  • Optimize sites for responsiveness, performance, and accessibility;
  • Stay on top of design trends and share what you learn with the team.


What You’ll Bring


  • Strong English skills (you’ll be in calls with US clients);
  • 10+ years of experience in web design, especially for SaaS or tech;
  • Killer portfolio with websites that show your visual and technical chops;
  • Solid knowledge of Framer (must-have), Figma, Illustrator, and Photoshop;
  • A passion for sleek, clean, and functional design;
  • Ability to manage your time and deadlines independently.
  • UX/UI background;
  • Motion design or video editing (even basic);
  • Experience working with developers or low-code tools like Webflow.


Salary & Benefits:


  • USD $2000 (based on experience)
  • Fully remote team — work from anywhere
  • Growth-focused culture with tons of learning opportunities
  • Impact-driven projects with startups solving real problems
  • Friendly, supportive, and transparent environment


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, your work directly impacts fast-moving startups. You’ll have freedom to explore ideas, contribute to strategy, and help shape the future of digital design—all from wherever you are.


How to Apply


If you’re a web designer with a passion for solving complex problems and SaaS products, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Who We Are:


AdMaxTech is a leading mobile app user acquisition agency, working directly with top-tier advertisers across various app verticals. Our team brings together expertise from global tech giants and world-class performance marketing agencies.


Why Join Us:

  • Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely from your preferred location.
  • Be part of a fast-paced, results-driven environment in the booming mobile advertising industry.
  • The global mobile advertising market exceeded $280 billion in 2022 and is projected to reach $353 billion by 2025 — a 26% growth opportunity you can be part of.
  • Join a diverse, international team with a strong focus on collaboration, growth, and performance.


Your Role:

As a Business Development Manager, you will play a crucial role in expanding our advertiser partnerships and driving revenue growth. Your main responsibilities include:

✔ Research and identify the right decision-makers within potential advertiser organizations.

✔ Conduct pitch meetings and negotiations with prospective clients, aiming to close new deals.

✔ Collaborate closely with our internal teams to ensure a smooth onboarding process for new clients.

✔ Maintain up-to-date records and follow-up activities in our internal tracking system.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong research and communication skills.
  • Proven experience in business development, sales, or account management, preferably in digital marketing, mobile apps, or ad-tech.
  • Self-driven, organized, and result-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.


Why It’s Exciting:

The mobile app industry is growing fast — so are we. This is your opportunity to make a direct impact, contribute to our success, and grow your career alongside experienced professionals.


*AdMaxTech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Product Designer Senior
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Senior experience: 7+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a senior product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
About the Role and Reponsabilities:

In this role you will have the chance to build large additions to our platform ecosystem, contributing to an infrastructure that centralizes our ETL and streaming infrastructure, enables experimentation and data development, and powers algorithm development. You will design and build scalable engineering solutions to solve business and data problems.


Core tech stack used by this role:

-S3 using Parquet and Iceberg for data storage

-Hive and Iceberg REST catalog as our metadata store

-Spark (Python, SQL, Scala) for data transformation

-Go, Scala and Java for backend development

-Kafka for data streaming

-Kubernetes and Helm for service deployments

-AWS IAM for access control

-Datadog for logging alerting and monitoring

-Trino as our federated query engine

-Identify, develop, and evangelize tooling, approaches, and data products that raise the bar of validity in experiment design and analyses across the company

-Collaborate with multiple teams and functions to deliver deep-dive analyses and experiment design for new initiatives and high-priority business areas

-Develop and iterate on our processes to empower more efficient and rigorous experimentation


Requirements

-You have a degree in an engineering or computer science field

-You have solid experience in platform engineering, with experience on experimentation platforms

-You have experience coding at a production level in Python, Go, Scala or Java

-You’ve built and supported RBAC systems used by enterprise-wide teams

-You have experience supporting Iceberg-based data warehouses



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


The JDE Developer is responsible for designing and implementing JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces programs utilizing the JDE developer toolkit owned by the GTS Corporate Applications team. This position serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource for JD Enterprise One (JDE), supporting processes, and implementing improvements. The JDE Developer ensures appropriate controls are in place and integrates data for decision makers and business owners to support IT, Compliance, project, and vendor management activities. The JDE Developer will be focused on the Global Systems Implementation, initially on the LatAm and UK/EMEA regions.


Responsibilities:

JDE Developer responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert developer for JD Edwards Enterprise One (JDE) associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Gather business requirements and implement a global standard design for the Global Systems Implementation of JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces with other client applications

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient

• Ensure JDE development deliverables are completed on time and bug free

• Based on detailed requirements, analyze business needs, create appropriate functional and technical designs, develop the programs, and perform testing to ensure quality of the deliverables.

• Ensure JDE programs are compliant with client IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.


Required :

• Technical knowledge of JD Edwards Enterprise One 9.1 or higher, including application configuration and development

• Experience with JDE Localization implementations, preferably for LatAm countries

• Strong financial applications, analysis and issue resolution (trouble shooting) skills

• Experience working with fellow team members and third party vendors to integrate with SaaS solutions

• Working ""hands-on"" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

• Fluent in Spanish and English

• Availability to work CST timezone


Desired :

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Understanding of integration with Identity Management solutions

• Moderate level proficiency with Microsoft Visio or Lucid

• Intermediate SQL query skills

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

  • Inglês avançado para conversação;

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Vaga: SDR (Sales Development Representative) — Reborn

A Reborn é uma fintech feita por quem viveu o outro lado.

A gente nasceu pra ser a infra que sellers e negócios digitais realmente confiam.

E agora, estamos procurando um SDR com sangue nos olhos , que saiba abrir porta, criar oportunidade e não espere o lead cair no colo.

O que você vai fazer
  • Prospectar ativamente novos sellers nos nichos que a Reborn atua
  • Fazer abordagens frias inteligentes (WhatsApp, e-mail e LinkedIn);
  • Qualificar leads inbound e outbound, identificando fit e potencial de volume;
  • Entender o negócio do cliente e mostrar como a Reborn pode escalar o faturamento dele;
  • Alimentar e atualizar o CRM com consistência;
  • Trabalhar junto com o time de Closers pra garantir transição fluida e fechamento rápido;
  • Testar cadências, mensagens e novas formas de gerar conversas que virem contrato.
O que buscamos
  • Perfil comercial raiz , comunicativo, disciplinado e com energia alta;
  • Experiência com prospecção outbound  e qualificação de leads (B2B);
  • Mentalidade de dono entende que vender é resolver o problema do cliente, não empurrar produto;
  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma persuasiva, especialmente via WhatsApp e e-mail;
  • Organização e controle de pipeline no CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, RD ou similar).
Diferenciais
  • Já ter atuado em fintech, pagamentos, SaaS ou performance;
  • Saber vender pra founders e tomadores de decisão;
O que oferecemos
  • Salário fixo competitivo + variável agressiva;
  • Estrutura com marketing, motion e branding pra apoiar as ações comerciais;
  • Time de alta performance e crescimento acelerado;
  • Modelo remoto (com preferência pra quem está em SP ).

 Envie seu currículo e uma mensagem curta contando por que você quer estar na Reborn para:

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Manager to join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Develop partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Web Front End Developer - Senior/Lead/Architect - Brazil
description:
About Kore Geosystems


Kore Geosystems is at the forefront of technology, leveraging AI and advanced software to deliver innovative solutions for the mining industry. Our products empower geologists and engineers to capture, manage, and analyze geological data faster and more accurately. With leadership experience from companies like Microsoft, our team combines deep technical expertise with a vision to transform how data powers mining operations.


The Opportunity


We’re seeking a hands-on Web Front-End Architect to lead Kore’s efforts in modern web application development. You’ll define and implement the front-end architecture for our next-generation platforms using ReactJS, TypeScript, Hooks, and Context API —while coding day-to-day.

This role requires deep technical ownership, architectural thinking, and the ability to work across multiple complex applications that integrate data visualization, analytics, and AI features.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead and own the front-end architecture and design of scalable, high-performance web applications.
  • Develop and maintain applications using ReactJS, TypeScript, Hooks, Context API , and Redux/Flux patterns.
  • Design responsive, modular, and reusable UI components using frameworks like Material UI , Bootstrap , or Tailwind .
  • Work closely with backend and DevOps teams to ensure seamless CI/CD integration (preferably on Azure DevOps ).
  • Implement secure front-end integrations with Azure AD B2C or equivalent identity systems.
  • Use SVG and D3.js for advanced data visualizations (annotations, charting, and reporting).
  • Collaborate with product, design, and data teams to translate complex requirements into intuitive, performant UI solutions.
  • Ensure accessibility, cross-browser compatibility, and responsive design standards.
  • Drive front-end code quality, best practices, and technical mentorship within the team.


Required Skills & Experience


  • 15+ years of professional experience in front-end or full-stack web development.
  • Expert-level proficiency in:
  • ReactJS , TypeScript , Context API , Hooks , and Redux/Flux patterns
  • HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+)
  • Solid understanding of Node.js concepts and front-end build pipelines.
  • Strong experience with responsive design frameworks (React Material, Bootstrap, Tailwind).
  • Hands-on experience with SVG and D3.js for visualizations.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred).
  • Familiarity with security best practices , OAuth2 , and Azure B2C authentication.
  • Strong debugging, optimization, and performance tuning skills.
  • 100% hands-on coding; ability to set architectural standards and lead by example.


Preferred Technologies


  • React Material Design
  • SVG / D3.js for data-driven UI
  • Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines
  • Azure B2C for authentication and user management
  • React Router , Functional Components , and React Hooks


Who You Are


  • A technical leader who enjoys hands-on coding and architectural problem-solving.
  • Passionate about creating elegant, maintainable, and scalable UI systems.
  • Curious about data visualization, real-time apps, and next-gen UI technologies.
  • Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional, global teams.


Benefits


  • Health insurance for employee and family.
  • Two weeks of vacation + one week of sick leave annually.
  • Work-from-anywhere flexibility (Brazil only).
  • Annual performance bonus and salary revision.



Equal Opportunity


Kore Geosystems is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Title: VIP Account Manager

Location: Brazil -Remote


************ *Note - PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE IGAMING EXPERIENCE ******************


Our client, a well-known Brazilian gambling operator, is looking for a motivated VIP Account Manager to assist in managing and growing the VIP customer segment to help and assist the current VIP team in place.


This role will focus on building strong client relationships, supporting engagement strategies, and helping improve the overall VIP experience. It’s a great opportunity for someone with account management experience who wants to develop their skills in a dynamic industry.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Assist in identifying and onboarding new VIP clients through prospecting and networking.


  • Support the management of VIP client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction.


  • Help execute engagement and retention strategies to increase player loyalty.


  • Work closely with senior team members to design and implement and improve VIP incentives, promotions, and personalized offers.


  • Monitor key performance metrics such as betting volume, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention rates, and customer lifetime value (LTV).


  • Assist in preparing reports on VIP performance and account development.


  • Ensure compliance with responsible gaming and company policies.



Skills & Qualifications :


  • Experience in account management, sales, or customer service, preferably in the betting or online gaming industry.


  • A wallet or existing player base would be incredibly valuable and sought after.


  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build client relationships.


  • Basic knowledge of sports betting and online casino market is a plus.


  • Comfortable working with data and reports to understand customer behavior.


  • Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.


  • Ability to work flexible hours when needed.


This role is ideal for someone eager to grow in VIP management, with the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in the field and business.

Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing ;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos , apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter ;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca ;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas ;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
SOBRE A LETS


A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.


Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística para negócios. Se você é uma pessoa com conhecimentos em vendas e na plataforma do HubSpot , apaixonada por resultados, métricas e empresas em pleno crescimento a LET'S é o seu lugar!


SOBRE A VAGA


Estamos em busca de um(a) SDR — Sales Development Representative para impulsionar a geração de demanda e criação de pipeline comercial em contas B2B (médio e enterprise). Você será responsável por prospecção outbound, qualificação de leads inbound, agendamento de reuniões qualificadas (SQLs) e pelo handoff fluido para o time de Vendas (AEs) .


No dia a dia, usará HubSpot (Sales/Marketing Hub) para rodar cadências multicanal (e-mail, ligação, WhatsApp/LinkedIn), segmentar listas, personalizar abordagens por ICP/persona e operar um processo data-driven com SLAs de resposta (lead response time) , taxas de conversão e show rate sob acompanhamento constante. Trabalhará em sintonia com Marketing (ABM, campanhas e conteúdo) e com Vendas (territórios, critérios de passagem, feedbacks de qualidade).


ATIVIDADES


  • Inbound: atender leads rapidamente (SLA de minutos ), qualificar (BANT/CHAMP/MEDDICC-lite), registrar contexto e agendar reunião com AE.
  • Outbound: construir listas por ICP/persona, pesquisa de conta/decisores , rodar cadências no HubSpot (e-mail, call, WhatsApp/LinkedIn), personalizando mensagens e hipóteses de dor/valor.
  • ABM & personalização: trabalhar contas-alvo junto do Marketing (páginas ABM/Webflow, conteúdos e ofertas), adaptando pitch por segmento (varejo, last-mile, marketplaces B2B).
  • Qualificação & handoff: aplicar critérios claros de passagem (fit, timing, dor, potencial), registrar notas/objetivos próximos passos e garantir handoff sem fricção.
  • Métricas & rotina: controlar LRT, taxa de resposta, reuniões marcadas, show rate, SQLs , pipeline criado e conversões por etapa/canal; sugerir testes de assunto, templates e cadências.
  • CRM disciplina: manter HubSpot atualizado (propriedades, atividades, próximos passos), gerir tasks, listas e sequences com organização exemplar.
  • Feedback de mercado: coletar sinais (objeções, concorrentes, requisitos), produzir insights para Vendas, Marketing e Produto; fechar o loop com aprendizados.
  • Compliance & boas práticas: seguir políticas de opt-in/opt-out, LGPD , UTMs e qualidade de dados em todas as interações.


REQUISITOS


  • Experiência comprovada (2+ anos) como SDR/BDR em SaaS B2B ou soluções complexas (ciclo consultivo).
  • Domínio de HubSpot (Sales Hub) no dia a dia (lists, sequences, tasks, deals, snippets, playbooks, relatórios básicos).
  • Prospecção outbound e qualificação inbound aplicando BANT ou CHAMP (ou equivalente) e perguntas consultivas (SPIN) ; cadências multicanal no HubSpot (e-mail, ligação, WhatsApp/LinkedIn) com disciplina de CRM.
  • Escrita clara e persuasiva (frio → quente), comunicação verbal confiante para ligações.
  • Organização e disciplina de CRM (registro de atividades, follow-ups, prazos).
  • Foco em metas (reuniões/SQLs/pipeline criado) e melhoria contínua via dados.
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de materiais, e-mails e benchmarks.
  • Diferencial forte (não eliminatório): certificações HubSpot (Sales Software/Inbound) ou trilhas concluídas na HubSpot Academy/LinkedIn Learning.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS


  • Vivência em empesas de software (SaaS) ; logística/last-mile, varejo ou marketplaces B2B .
  • Experiência com LinkedIn Sales Navigator , ferramentas de prospecção (Apollo/Lusha/Hunter) e WhatsApp Business integrado ao HubSpot.
  • MEDDICC-lite/Challenger , ABM com mapeamento de decisores/buying committee, Sales Navigator , testes A/B de cadências/assuntos e co-criação de playbooks com AEs/Marketing.
  • Noções de ABM (contas-alvo, buying committee, mensagens por persona).
  • Integrações e automações com n8n ; familiaridade com Webflow ↔ HubSpot .
  • Espanhol básico é um plus.


BENEFÍCIOS


  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados.
  • Comissão direta sobre as vendas.
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:


  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .
  • Como se destacar: envie links das certificações HubSpot , cases mensuráveis (ex.: ganho de conversão, redução de LRT, melhora de deliverability), prints/redashboards e uma breve descrição de arquiteturas de objetos/pipelines que você implementou e; faça os cursos dentro da HubSpot Academy ou no próprio LinkedIn comprovando seus conhecimentos.

Junte-se a nós!


Aqui, você encontra excelentes oportunidades para o desenvolvimento da sua carreira.

▶️Desafio: Trabalhamos com as tecnologias mais inovadoras de nossos parceiros estratégicos

▶️Plano de Carreira: Hoje, a maioria do corpo diretivo e gerencial são de profissionais formados em nossos quadros.

  • Domínio da linguagem de programação Java 17 (ou superior), utilizando-se dos padrões da plataforma:
  • JPA: Framework persistência objetos Java;
  • CDI: Mecanismo de injeção componente (ex.: Enterprise JavaBeans)
  • JMS: API transmissão de mensagens;
  • API REST (JSON) e Swagger (ferramentas especificação);
  • Framework Java Quarkus (Containers);
  • Framework Apache Camel (integração);
  • Versionamento de código com Git (GitLab);
  • Banco de Dados Oracle ou SQL Server;
  • Conhecimento Maven - ferramenta automação compilação;
  • Diferencial:

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Ruby on Rails Junior
description:
Salário: R$ 3.500,00

Benefícios: Swile Refeição | Swile Alimentação | Plano de saúde Porto Seguro | Ajuda de custo home office| Auxílio Educação | Seguro de vida | Day Off Aniversariante | Gift Card Aniversariante

Modalidade de Trabalho : remoto (Home office)

Resumo da Função:

Desenvolver soluções completas de ferramenta web junto com a equipe de desenvolvimento no framework Ruby on Rails e Reactjs.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver funcionalidades novas, expandir o sistema. Criar uma especificação técnica e implementar a solução na plataforma dentro do prazo.
  • Investigar e corrigir bugs, garantir o funcionamento da plataforma e a estabilidade do serviço.
  • Auxiliar na manutenção, atualização dos serviços, revisão de código e desenvolver testes unitários, funcionais e de integração nos diferentes ambientes da aplicação, visando verificar se o programa executa suas funções corretamente dentro do especificado. 
  • Aperfeiçoar conhecimentos técnicos, através de pesquisas, estudo de manuais e participação em cursos, visando a otimização da utilização dos recursos disponíveis na empresa.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Raciocínio Lógico
  • Organização (planejamento)
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe
  • Foco em ação
  • Vontade de aprender

  • Curso superior em Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou cursos correlatos.(completo ou cursando)
  • Conhecimento em Ruby on Rails

title: Product Owner - Wealth Management
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Business Analyst to drive requirements gathering, user interface design, and functional specifications for a high-impact greenfield initiative: a new wealth management platform built on Oracle Database, with a Java backend and Angular frontend. You will play a central role in shaping the application from the ground up and leveraging AI to accelerate and improve the delivery of requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to capture and refine business requirements, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and completeness.
  • Partner with UI/UX designers and developers to define and validate UI requirements and user journeys.
  • Break down requirements into PBIs (Product Backlog Items) to support Agile delivery.
  • Document technical aspects for the UI, backend services, and integrations, ensuring developers understand what is needed.
  • Apply AI-driven tools and methods to accelerate requirement gathering, analysis, and documentation.
  • Contribute to building internal tools and accelerators that can be leveraged across projects.
  • Ensure requirements align with wealth management best practices, including security, goal planning, and regulatory compliance.


Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst in wealth management.
  • Ability to understand UI design and development from the ground up and translate UI/UX needs into actionable requirements.
  • Familiarity with Oracle, Java, and Angular technologies.
  • Strong understanding of services architecture to effectively communicate requirements to developers.
  • Innovative mindset and strong interest in leveraging AI to improve processes and accelerate requirement delivery.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, greenfield environment.
  • Curiosity and proactive attitude toward building tools and processes that benefit other projects using AI.


Location : Tampa, US (Hybrid – 50% in the office) – as a Contractor

OR remote from Brazil – as a Contractor

title: Inside Sales | Vendas Whatsapp
description:
we are FASHION CLOSET


estamos em busca de uma Inside Sales  com perfil altamente comercial, movida por metas e que domine a arte de vender através do whatsApp. essa pessoa será responsável por conduzir conversas com clientes, entender suas necessidades, apresentar soluções com argumentos persuasivos e garantir que cada atendimento seja uma oportunidade real de conversão.

mais do que vender, queremos alguém que pense estrategicamente a jornada do cliente , use técnicas modernas de negociação e saiba explorar oportunidades de cross-sell e up-sell  com naturalidade e eficiência.


principais responsabilidades

  • realizar atendimentos ativos e receptivos via WhatsApp com foco total em conversão de vendas;
  • dominar técnicas de vendas consultivas, negociação e fechamento;
  • utilizar ferramentas de CRM para gestão do funil e acompanhamento de leads;
  • aplicar estratégias de cross-sell e up-sell em oportunidades reais de negócio;
  • trabalhar com scripts e também construir abordagens personalizadas conforme o perfil do cliente;
  • manter relacionamento contínuo com a base de clientes, entendendo suas necessidades e antecipando soluções;
  • buscar constantemente superar metas e contribuir com ideias que ampliem o faturamento.


requisitos

  • experiência comprovada com vendas via WhatsApp ou Inside Sales (obrigatório);
  • conhecimento em técnicas de vendas consultivas, negociação e fechamento;
  • capacidade de comunicação escrita impecável e abordagem persuasiva;
  • organização e habilidade com ferramentas de CRM;
  • disposição para ir além do básico e entregar resultado acima da média.


diferenciais

  • experiência no segmento de moda feminina;
  • conhecer a Fashion Closet e sua proposta de valor.


oferecemos

  • ambiente dinâmico e inclusivo
  • comissão sobre vendas
  • benefícios


somos uma empresa de moda feminina que busca trazer para as clientes o que há de mais trend no Brasil e mundo afora. focamos em estilo, qualidade, velocidade, sem perder a excelência na experiência da cliente.

aqui na FASHION buscamos pessoas verdadeiras, com brilho nos olhos e inquietas pelo novo.

a nossa missão é criar produtos que elevem a auto estima das clientes e as tornem poderosas.

a nossa missão também é participar positivamente de alguma forma da construção dos sonhos das nossas clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores e sociedade.

vem com a gente!
